```{bash}
#find the longgf results
#grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.run.MCF7_PacBio_SRX905986.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.MCF7_PacBio_SRX905986.tsv

grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF*K562*ENCODE*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.K562.PacBio.tsv
grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF*SGNex*K562*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.K562.Nanopore.tsv
grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF*SGNex*MCF7*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.MCF7.Nanopore.tsv
grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF*MCF7*ENCODE*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.MCF7.PacBio.tsv

grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF*MCF7*ENCODE*.log
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
```


```{r}
####Read in Data
#LongGF
my_files <- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF", full.names=TRUE)
all_tsv <-lapply(my_files, read.table)
names(all_tsv) <- gsub(".tsv","",list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF",full.names = FALSE),fixed = TRUE)
names <- gsub(".tsv","", list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF",full.names = FALSE),fixed = TRUE)
df <- as.data.frame(all_csv$nameofyourfilename)
for(i in names){
  assign(i, read.table(paste0("/bioinformatics/ryley/", i, ".tsv")))
}
my_files <- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF", full.names=TRUE)
LongGF <- do.call(rbind, lapply(my_files, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(filename))
}))

LongGF$V1[LongGF$V1=="SumGF"] <- "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling/LongGF.run.MCF7_ENCODE_ENCFF887DGG_PacBio.log:SumGF"
#Genion
myfiles<- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling", pattern = "*_genion\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("SRX905986", myfiles)]
Genion<- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  if (file.info(filename)$size > 0) {
    read.table(filename) %>%
      mutate(Source = basename(filename))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))


myfiles<- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling", pattern = "K562.*_genion\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("PacBio", myfiles)]
genion_K562_Nanopore <- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(filename))
}))

file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("SGNex", myfiles)]
genion_K562_PacBio <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(filename))
}))
  
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling", pattern = "MCF.*_genion\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("PacBio", myfiles)]
genion_MCF7_Nanopore <- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  if (file.info(filename)$size > 0) {
    read.table(filename) %>%
      mutate(Source = basename(filename))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))

file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("SGNex|SRX905986", myfiles)]
genion_MCF7_PacBio <- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  if (file.info(filename)$size > 0) {
    read.table(filename) %>%
      mutate(Source = basename(filename))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))  

#JAFFAL
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling", pattern = "jaffa_results.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("sim|05Feb24|SRX905986", myfiles)]
JAFFAL <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE, sep = ",") %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(dirname(filename)))
}))

JAFFAL_K562_PacBio <- JAFFAL[grepl("PacBio", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("K562", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
JAFFAL_K562_Nanopore <- JAFFAL[!grepl("PacBio", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("K562", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
JAFFAL_MCF7_PacBio <- JAFFAL[grepl("PacBio", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("MCF", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
JAFFAL_MCF7_Nanopore <- JAFFAL[!grepl("PacBio", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("MCF", JAFFAL$sample, ignore.case = TRUE), ]

#fusionseeker
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/fusion_calling", pattern = "confident_genefusion.txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("sim|05Feb24|SRX905986", myfiles)]
FusionSeeker <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(dirname(filename)))
}))

FusionSeeker_K562_PacBio <- FusionSeeker[grepl("PacBio", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("K562", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
FusionSeeker_K562_Nanopore <- FusionSeeker[!grepl("PacBio", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("K562", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
FusionSeeker_MCF7_PacBio <- FusionSeeker[grepl("PacBio", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("MCF", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
FusionSeeker_MCF7_Nanopore <- FusionSeeker[!grepl("PacBio", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("MCF", FusionSeeker$Source, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
```

```{r}
#find impossible fusions chrM x genomic genes
mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerK562 <- rbind(mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_K562_PacBio, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM") | (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_K562_Nanopore, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM") | (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_MCF7_PacBio, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM") | (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_MCF7_Nanopore, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM") | (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

mito_chimeras_LongGFK562 <- rbind(mutate(filter(LongGF.K562.PacBio, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(filter(LongGF.K562.Nanopore, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) , platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
mito_chimeras_LongGFMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(filter(LongGF.MCF7.PacBio, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(filter(LongGF.MCF7.Nanopore, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) , platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

mito_chimeras_GENIONK562 <- rbind(filter(genion_K562_PacBio, grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)), filter(genion_K562_Nanopore, grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)))
mito_chimeras_GENIONMCF7 <- rbind(filter(genion_MCF7_PacBio, grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)), filter(genion_MCF7_Nanopore, grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)))

mito_chimeras_JAFFALK562 <- rbind(mutate(subset(JAFFAL_K562_PacBio, (chrom1 == "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM") | (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(subset(JAFFAL_K562_Nanopore, (chrom1 == "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM") | (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
mito_chimeras_JAFFALMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(subset(JAFFAL_MCF7_PacBio , (chrom1 == "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM") | (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(subset(JAFFAL_MCF7_Nanopore, (chrom1 == "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM") | (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 == "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

mito_chimeras <- rbind(mutate(rename(rbind(mito_chimeras_LongGFMCF7[c(3,(ncol(mito_chimeras_LongGFMCF7)-1) ,ncol(mito_chimeras_LongGFMCF7))], mito_chimeras_LongGFK562[c(3,(ncol(mito_chimeras_LongGFK562)-1) ,ncol(mito_chimeras_LongGFK562))]), "NumSupp"="V3"), Algorithm = "LongGF"), mutate(rbind(mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerK562[c(4, (ncol(mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerK562)-1), ncol(mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerK562))], mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerMCF7[c(4, (ncol(mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerMCF7)-1), ncol(mito_chimeras_FusionSeekerMCF7))]) , Algorithm = "FusionSeeker"))

ggplot(mito_chimeras, aes(x = NumSupp, fill = Algorithm)) + #, linetype = platform
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+  # Optional: Customize color palette
 #scale_x_log10()+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(1, 25))

ggplot(mito_chimeras, aes(x = NumSupp, fill = Algorithm)) + #, linetype = platform
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")+  # Optional: Customize color palette
 scale_x_log10()+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(100, 300), ylim = c(0,0.5))

ggplot(mito_chimeras, aes(x = NumSupp))+
  geom_histogram(data = subset(mito_chimeras, Algorithm == "LongGF"), fill = 'red', alpha=0.5)+
  geom_histogram(data = subset(mito_chimeras, Algorithm == "FusionSeeker"), fill = 'blue', alpha=0.2)+
  scale_x_log10()

frequency_mito_chimeras <-  mito_chimeras %>%
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n()) %>% unique()

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_y_log10()

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(cell)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(1, 100), ylim = c(0, 30))


```

```{r}
# removing impossible fusions from results

nomito_FusionSeekerK562 <- rbind(mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_K562_PacBio, (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_K562_Nanopore, (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_MCF7_PacBio, (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(subset(FusionSeeker_MCF7_Nanopore, (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

nomito_LongGFK562 <- rbind(mutate(filter(LongGF.K562.PacBio, (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) ), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(filter(LongGF.K562.Nanopore, (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) , platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
nomito_LongGFMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(filter(LongGF.MCF7.PacBio, (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) ), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(filter(LongGF.MCF7.Nanopore, (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) , platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

nomito_GENIONK562 <- rbind(mutate(filter(genion_K562_PacBio, !grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562"), mutate(filter(genion_K562_Nanopore, !grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562"))
nomito_GENIONMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(filter(genion_MCF7_PacBio, !grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7"), filter(genion_MCF7_Nanopore, !grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE)))

nomito_JAFFALK562 <- rbind(mutate(subset(JAFFAL_K562_PacBio, (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "K562" ), mutate(subset(JAFFAL_K562_Nanopore, (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "K562" ))
nomito_JAFFALMCF7 <- rbind(mutate(subset(JAFFAL_MCF7_PacBio , (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "PacBio", cell = "MCF7" ), mutate(subset(JAFFAL_MCF7_Nanopore, (chrom1 != "chrM" & chrom2 != "chrM")), platform = "Nanopore", cell = "MCF7" ))

```

```{r}
#filter self-fusions
self_LongGFK562 <- nomito_LongGFK562 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 == V2.2)
self_LongGFMCF7 <- nomito_LongGFMCF7 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 == V2.2)

self_FusionSeekerK562 <- nomito_FusionSeekerK562 %>% subset(Gene1 == Gene2)
self_FusionSeekerMCF7 <- nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7 %>% subset(Gene1 == Gene2)

self_GENIONK562 <- nomito_GENIONK562 %>% separate(V1, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep="::", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V1.1 == V1.2)
self_GENIONKMCF7 <- nomito_GENIONMCF7 %>% separate(V1, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep="::", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V1.1 == V1.2)

self_JAFFALK562 <- nomito_JAFFALK562 %>% separate(fusion.genes, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V1.1 == V1.2)
self_JAFFALMCF7 <- nomito_JAFFALMCF7 %>% separate(fusion.genes, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V1.1 == V1.2)

selfish <- rbind(self_LongGFK562, self_LongGFMCF7)[c(5, (ncol(self_LongGFK562)-1), ncol(self_LongGFK562))] %>% 
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n(), Algorithm = "LongGF") %>% unique()

ggplot((selfish), aes(x = V3, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(cell)))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of self fusions",
    x = "Read Support")+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(1, 25), ylim = c(0, 25))
```

```{r}
selfless_LongGFK562 <- nomito_LongGFK562 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 != V2.2)
selfless_LongGFMCF7 <- nomito_LongGFMCF7 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 != V2.2)

selfless <- rbind(mutate(rename(rbind(selfless_LongGFMCF7[c(5,(ncol(selfless_LongGFMCF7)-1) ,ncol(selfless_LongGFMCF7))], selfless_LongGFK562[c(5,(ncol(selfless_LongGFK562)-1) ,ncol(selfless_LongGFK562))]), "NumSupp"="V3"), Algorithm = "LongGF"),
                  
                  mutate(rbind(nomito_FusionSeekerK562[c(4, (ncol(nomito_FusionSeekerK562)-1), ncol(nomito_FusionSeekerK562))], nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7[c(4, (ncol(nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7)-1), ncol(nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7))]) , Algorithm = "FusionSeeker"),
                  mutate(rename(rbind(mutate(nomito_GENIONK562[5], ), nomito_GENIONK562[5]), "NumSupp"="V5"), Algorithm = "Genion"),
                  mutate(rename(rbind(nomito_JAFFALK562[11], nomito_JAFFALMCF7[11]), "NumSupp"="spanning.reads"), Algorithm = "JAFFAL"))

```
